title: thebasics:thebasics-handbook-title-scene-markers
text: Scene markers hold persistent roleplay descriptions without filling a build with large written signs. Craft one from any two loose stones, then place the small marker flat on the ground or against a wall. Writing and reading - Hold Shift and right-click a placed marker to edit its title, body, and display mode. - Choose When targeted, Always nearby, or On interaction for floating descriptions. Always nearby has its own text distance and Unlimited setting. - Plain right-click opens the complete description in every mode. The top-middle inspector shows a short preview. The floating symbol invites nearby players to inspect it. - Press Mark as read in that reader once you know a marker: its bubble disappears for you and its symbol dims to half, until you mark it unread. Any edit, pickup, or the editor's Clear read button makes it new again for everyone. - Break a marker to pick it up with its title, description, presentation, and author metadata intact. Hold Shift and right-click the item to read it. Editing follows normal land-claim permissions. Scene markers are durable world content, separate from temporary /envhere and !! cast messages and separate from local or global OOC chat settings. Locking The creator can toggle the lock icon at the top right of the editor, then Save. No padlock item is needed. Locked markers remain readable and open read-only. Only the creator or a server admin with claim access can unlock them using that icon in the editor or pick them up. Locks and creator identity survive pickup and replacement. Appearance Use the symbol tiles and preview to choose an exclamation, question, information, solid dot, hollow ring, or diamond billboard. The Other icons... button beside them opens the same icon catalog as the title icon, so the floating symbol can be any icon in your color; a symbol tile clears that choice again. All indicators use a plain, partially transparent style. Idle bobbing can be toggled in the editor. The camera-facing symbol grows slightly when targeted; the floating text bubble stays still. Choose yellow, white, blue, green or red, and adjust its height from -0.5 to 4 blocks. Indicator size is independently adjustable from 25 to 300 percent, with 100 percent as the original size. Bubble size independently scales the text and its background from 40 to 200 percent, default 100. Longer descriptions grow the bubble without shrinking the letters. The Icon button beside the title opens a searchable, paginated picker of built-in VTML icons, registered mod icons, and loaded SVG icons. The larger icon sits to the left of the title, with space reserved for wrapped text. Choose None to remove it. The live preview shows your symbol and bubble together. Show description in bubble is off by default: the bubble shows only its title. Turn it on to include the description. Right-click always opens the full text. Billboard distance accepts 1-1024 blocks (default 24). Unlimited removes the distance fade but still requires loaded terrain. Walls obscure the billboard. Nearby text defaults to 8 blocks and can fade independently from the icon. Fresh markers remember your last saved appearance on this server with empty text. Picked-up markers retain their own settings. Appearance settings survive pickup and replacement, and locked markers must be unlocked before changing them.
